capabilities: Search KOBIS for a movie by the note filename
Fetch TMDB poster images and ratings
Toggle optional metadata fields and add custom fields
Rename the file to a safe title
disambiguation: Not a movie search browser; it fills frontmatter for a note whose filename is a Korean movie title.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up movie data from Korean and international film databases, so users must enter movie metadata by hand.
summary: Fetches Korean movie metadata from KOBIS and TMDB APIs using the note filename and auto-fills the frontmatter.
